name: Clinical Clean
signature: Bright white, cool slate text, teal-cyan accent, airy 12px-radius cards, trust checks.

contrast.note: Light theme. Cyan-teal is safe as text on both backgrounds. White on accent passes AA for buttons.

motion.rule: Quiet and quick: elements fade up 28px over 600ms, 70ms apart, then stay still; nothing loops.

hero.layout: Left: headline, one-line promise, primary call button, three check-mark facts (only real credentials, licenses and years). Right: clean photo of the real practice or team in a 20px-radius frame with a subtle shadow.
hero.photo: Real photo of the actual premises or staff; no stock lab coats.

background: White with one very soft radial wash of the accent at 6% opacity in the top-left of the hero. Hairline dividers in ink at 10% between sections.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label; secondary is a 1px slate outline.
button.label: Weight 600, sentence case.
button.hover: Press feedback with data-press; colors do not animate.

banned: stock photos of models in lab coats
